_comment: Hand-maintained record of OBR Economic & Fiscal Outlook headline figures, one entry per OBR publication. The adapter's live `fetch()` emits the head-of-list (newest) entry; `fetchHistorical()` emits one observation per vintage inside the requested range so backfilled days carry the right cb_headroom / psnfl_trajectory through to the next vintage. Values are nominal GBP billions for headroom and percentage points of GDP for psnfl trajectory. Update whenever OBR publishes (twice yearly + any in-year update). TODO(source): swap for OBR's headline-data CSV ingest once OBR exposes one at a stable URL.

_headroom_audit.definition: Target-year current-budget surplus, in GBP billions, using the detailed OBR tables rather than rounded executive-summary text. A negative current-budget deficit in the target year is positive headroom.
_headroom_audit.2026-03-03: OBR March 2026 EFO, Annex A fiscal aggregates: 2029-30 current-budget deficit -23.6. Source: https://assets.publishing.service.gov.uk/media/69a6d7b62e1f4fbda4252208/economic-and-fiscal-outlook-march-2026-web-accessible.pdf
_headroom_audit.2025-11-26: OBR November 2025 EFO, Table A.9: 2029-30 current-budget deficit -21.7. The executive summary rounds the margin to 22 billion; the previous fixture used that rounded number. Source: https://obr.uk/efo/economic-and-fiscal-outlook-november-2025/
_headroom_audit.2025-03-26: OBR March 2025 EFO, paragraphs 1.3 and 7.6: post-policy current-budget target margin 9.9. Source: https://obr.uk/efo/economic-and-fiscal-outlook-march-2025/
_headroom_audit.2024-10-30: OBR October 2024 EFO, paragraph 7.6: post-policy current-budget target margin 9.9. Source: https://obr.uk/docs/dlm_uploads/OBR_Economic_and_fiscal_outlook_Oct_2024.pdf
_headroom_audit.2026-10-28: OBR October 2026 EFO, Table 7.1 (printed p.161) and Table A.9 (p.188): 2029-30 current-budget margin 14.5, current-budget deficit -14.5. Published at 13:29:19 UTC per GOV.UK Article metadata. Summary text rounds to 15 billion. Source: https://assets.publishing.service.gov.uk/media/6ae1f7b839d29f3f9b9b3f36/economic-and-fiscal-outlook-october-2026-web-accessible.pdf
